authority_chain.kernel_route: BRepTools_ReShape with planar rotated target plus four OCCT ruled side surfaces, sew/fix and shell-to-solid normalization

bounded_scope: semantic local +X planar face is re-resolved after yaw+pitch source transforms
rotation axis is centered on the selected face and constrained to its tangent plane, with persisted 4:3 local-Y/local-Z coefficients
R001 uses 80x50x10 mm, yaw +30 deg, pitch +20 deg and +3 deg rotation
R002 uses 100x60x12 mm, yaw -25 deg, pitch -15 deg and -3 deg rotation
the target face remains planar while each adjacent side is rebuilt as an OCCT ruled surface between its fixed opposite edge and rotated target edge
both revisions remain valid single-solid six-face B-Rep results and preserve the opposite face center and area
actual signed face-normal rotation matches the requested angle and the semantic selected face remains reselectable
zero angle, angle outside the 10 degree bounded contract, axis normal component and zero custom-axis coefficients are rejected
FCStd and R001/R002 STEP persist selector, custom-axis semantics, coefficients and FreeCAD/OCCT authority
Blender creates two tessellated display derivatives and preserves source FCStd hash, axis identity, coefficients and DISPLAY_DERIVATIVE_ONLY authority across save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if the semantic selector or custom tangent-axis construction changes, ruled-side B-Rep reconstruction is replaced by planarized/mesh-authoritative geometry, angle/axis failure gates are removed, FreeCAD/OCCT version route changes without revalidation, or Blender save/reopen no longer preserves source hash and display-only authority.
authority_note: This receipt proves one bounded custom tangent-axis family for a full-3D-oriented planar selected face. The ruled adjacent surfaces are a consequence of that bounded edit and do not prove general nonplanar-face direct editing, unrestricted arbitrary-axis rotation, persistent topological naming, or P0-B PASS.
